description.value: The Trail Aquatic & Leisure Centre is the largest aquatic and multi-sport facility between Kelowna and Cranbrook, built in 1996 and recognized with several design awards. It features an 8-lane 25-metre competition pool, leisure pool, waterslide, diving boards, steam room, and a fully equipped fitness centre. Touring cyclists looking to recover with a swim or workout in the West Kootenay will find this a substantial public facility in the heart of Trail.
